mapper.sql: CASE #{granularity} WHEN 'MINUTE' THEN DATE_FORMAT(metric.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') WHEN 'HOUR' THEN DATE_FORMAT(metric.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') WHEN 'DAY' THEN DATE_FORMAT(metric.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(metric.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') END

sql.if: AND ( CASE WHEN definition.task_type IS NOT NULL THEN definition.task_type WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(definition.mode, '')) = 'FILE_SYNC' THEN 'FILE_TRANSFER' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(definition.job_type, '')) = 'STREAMING' THEN 'STREAM' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(definition.mode, '')) = 'GUIDE_SINGLE' AND UPPER(COALESCE(definition.source_type, '')) IN ('WEB_UPLOAD', 'FILE_RESOURCE', 'LOCAL_FILE') THEN 'FILE_INGEST' ELSE 'BATCH' END ) = #{taskType}

mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.inc_records), 0) AS totalRecords, COALESCE(SUM(t.inc_bytes), 0) AS totalBytes, COALESCE(COUNT(1), 0) AS totalTasks FROM ( SELECT metric.job_instance_id, SUM(metric.write_row_count) AS inc_records, SUM(metric.write_bytes) AS inc_bytes FROM t_seatunnel_web_job_metrics metric JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_instance instance ON instance.id = metric.job_instance_id JOIN t_seatunnel_web_job_definition definition ON definition.id = instance.job_definition_id WHERE metric.update_time >= #{startTime} AND metric.update_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY metric.job_instance_id ) t
